title: Misión de Emilie: Poble Sec y su modelo
description: docs/quests/emilie.md. The mission part by part from the picker (just dev-mission emilie <part>): her door, her flooded flat after Aitor's sketch, the laptop, inside her model zone by zone, El que no converge and the way back. Run it with --gpu.

steps.until: window.gerard && document.querySelector('#environment .place-name').textContent === 'Poble Sec · Carrer de Blai'

steps.caption: Poble Sec in chapter 2: her door on Margarit rings («Llamar al portal») instead of being looked at
Water runs out under the door; Emilie answers, polite and wrong
Up in her flat, just in by the door: a hand's depth of water over the hydraulic tiles; Emilie standing in it

steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.gerard.game.world(7, 8); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: c.x, y: 0, z: c.z }, 11); })()

steps.caption: The flat after Aitor's sketch: bathroom and terrace along the top, the desk over the sofa, the kitchen and its bar, the bedroom behind the projector's wall

steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.gerard.game.world(7, 2); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: c.x, y: 0, z: c.z }, 6); })()

steps.caption: The terrace: geraniums, and the leaves piled over the drain against the glass door. The why, for whoever looks
Talking to her: she keeps every fact and cannot join them
By the desk: her laptop, the model still running in phosphor green; «Conectarse»

steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.gerard.game.world(1.6, 5.5); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: c.x, y: .8, z: c.z }, 2.6); })()

steps.caption: The screen up close: the section's mesh, its water line, the orange stakes, «no converge» line after line
Aitor reads her model; they connect
Inside her model, where they land: the first stake ahead
Behind where they land, the way back to her laptop («Desconectarse»)
Las gravas, gone down by a stake of El suelo: an Oscilación sees them land, and it is a fight at once
El fondo: El que no converge ahead
Coming up to it: Emilie sees it from outside, then the fight
El que no converge beaten: back in the flat, and Emilie understands again
The mission done: Emilie, herself, in her flat
